newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nisseki House appoints vice president.
newsitem.headline: Nisseki House appoints vice president.

text.p: Nisseki House Industry Co Ltd said on Monday that it had created a new post of vice president because the company had not been able to contact its president since December 11.
Managing director Yuji Horiuchi was appointed vice president, the company, which makes prefabricated houses, said in a statement.
"We have not been able to contact president Saburo Horiuchi since December 11, so we appointed a vice president so he can do work on behalf of the president," the statement said.
The vice president is Saburo Horiuchi's son.
Saburo Horiuchi has not returned home since December 11, and his family reported his disappearance to the police on December 22, his son told a news conference.
"We don't know the reasons why he disappeared," the son said, without elaborating.
